quotes.text: Before you build something real, create a solution and put your work inside it from the very start.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: The single most important beginner habit for Power Platform ALM in one sentence.

quotes.text: A solution carries the recipe and the settings, and it doesn't carry your actual business data.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Clears up a common misconception about what moves with a solution.

quotes.text: Delete an unmanaged solution and only the container disappears because the customizations stay exactly where they are and quietly fall into the default solution.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Explains the surprising deletion behavior that separates unmanaged from managed solutions.

quotes.text: Pick a prefix on day one that actually means something like your company initials, and you'll never have to think about it again.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Concrete, actionable advice on an early decision that cannot be undone later.

quotes.text: A component is never really one thing, and it's whatever the top of its stack says it is.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Memorable summary of how solution layering determines runtime behavior.

takeaways: Put every app into a solution from day one, because a solution carries all components between environments while business data stays behind.
Build in the unmanaged solution in development, keep it in source control, and ship only the exported managed solution to test and production.
Use one publisher with a meaningful prefix and keep the number of solutions low to avoid layering surprises and circular dependencies.
hook: Power Platform apps built loose in an environment can vanish with one wrong uninstall and are painful to move. This episode explains solutions, managed versus unmanaged, publishers, layers and dependencies for makers and admins, so moving an app from development to production becomes routine instead of a gamble.
